# Wind technology powering tomorrow's energy systems

Siemens Gamesa is a global leader in wind energy, supporting companies and countries worldwide in
building resilient, affordable, and sustainable energy systems that accelerate the energy
transition.

Your trusted technology partner

#### Onshore

Operating in 81 countries, Siemens Gamesa offers an extensive range of onshore wind turbine
technologies to cover all wind classes and site conditions. By listening to our customers - and
backed up by over 40 years of experience - we know just what it takes to develop and manage a
successful onshore project.

[
[icon]
Read more ][30]

Powerful performance

#### Offshore

Leading the way forward, our engineers and technicians pioneered the offshore sector back in 1991,
with the world’s first wind power plant in Denmark. Since then, Siemens Gamesa has grown to become
the global leader in offshore power generation. Offering full-scope solutions and services, our
people and products will guarantee the success of your next offshore project.

[
[icon]
Read more ][31]

World-class maintenance

#### Service

Siemens Gamesa has a proven track record of excellence in operation and maintenance. Leveraging
scale and global reach, we offer a flexible service portfolio that can be tailored to our customers’
diverse operating models. We also provide advanced diagnostics and digitalization capabilities, as
well as customized offshore offerings.

**Career**

#### Passionate about renewables

It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy
for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters.

[ Join the team at Siemens Gamesa ][33]

**Sustainability**

#### Delivering sustainability through actions

This decade will be judged on our ability to take the steps needed to keep global temperature rises
this century to between 1.5 and 2.0 degrees Celsius, as well as deliver a fairer and more equal
world. That is why as part of our Sustainability Vision 2040, we are focused not just on the targets
we set, but instead on the actions that are needed to deliver on them.

[ More information ][34]
[Siemens Gamesa SG 15-236 offshore wind turbine installation]

### The next milestone on Siemens Gamesa's industrialization journey: SG 15-236

Offshore wind is entering a new era—one defined by scale, standardization, and technology-proven
reliability. With the introduction of the SG 15-236, Siemens Gamesa marks the next major step in the
industrialization of offshore wind energy.

 
* [ Read more ][35]

### Sustainability: From nice-to-have to prerequisite for winning

In popular culture, wind turbines often serve as a type of visual shorthand for the dream of a
sustainable future. But in the real world, sustainability considerations have evolved into strategic
drivers and enablers for our company and customers in Siemens Gamesa.

# Wind technology powering tomorrow's energy systems

Siemens Gamesa is a global leader in wind energy, supporting companies and countries worldwide in
building resilient, affordable, and sustainable energy systems that accelerate the energy
transition.

and our values.

Your trusted technology partner

#### Onshore

Operating in 81 countries, Siemens Gamesa offers an extensive range of onshore wind turbine
technologies to cover all wind classes and site conditions. By listening to our customers - and
backed up by over 40 years of experience - we know just what it takes to develop and manage a
successful onshore project.

Powerful performance

#### Offshore

Leading the way forward, our engineers and technicians pioneered the offshore sector back in 1991,
with the world’s first wind power plant in Denmark. Since then, Siemens Gamesa has grown to become
the global leader in offshore power generation. Offering full-scope solutions and services, our
people and products will guarantee the success of your next offshore project.

#### Service

Siemens Gamesa has a proven track record of excellence in operation and maintenance. Leveraging
scale and global reach, we offer a flexible service portfolio that can be tailored to our customers’
diverse operating models. We also provide advanced diagnostics and digitalization capabilities, as
well as customized offshore offerings.

**Career**

#### Passionate about renewables

It takes the brightest minds to be a technology leader. It takes imagination to create green energy
for the generations to come. At Siemens Gamesa we make real what matters.

[ Join the team at Siemens Gamesa ][33]

**Sustainability**

#### Delivering sustainability through actions

This decade will be judged on our ability to take the steps needed to keep global temperature rises
this century to between 1.5 and 2.0 degrees Celsius, as well as deliver a fairer and more equal
world. That is why as part of our Sustainability Vision 2040, we are focused not just on the targets
we set, but instead on the actions that are needed to deliver on them.

[ More information ][34]
[Siemens Gamesa SG 15-236 offshore wind turbine installation]

### The next milestone on Siemens Gamesa's industrialization journey: SG 15-236

Offshore wind is entering a new era—one defined by scale, standardization, and technology-proven
reliability. With the introduction of the SG 15-236, Siemens Gamesa marks the next major step in the
industrialization of offshore wind energy.

 
* [ Read more ][35]

### Sustainability: From nice-to-have to prerequisite for winning

In popular culture, wind turbines often serve as a type of visual shorthand for the dream of a
sustainable future. But in the real world, sustainability considerations have evolved into strategic
drivers and enablers for our company and customers in Siemens Gamesa.

## The global leader in sustainable energy solutions

We're on a mission to transform the global energy system. With a dedicated team of +35,000
employees, we work every day to shape a more sustainable future by designing, installing, and
maintaining wind energy projects worldwide.

We believe wind power will form the backbone of tomorrow’s energy system. That's why we're steadfast
in our commitment to solutions that drive the vital transition to renewable energy, with wind at the
core.

## Our sustainable energy solutions

[ [Onshore wind turbines] ][143]

##### Onshore wind turbines

We lead the onshore wind market with over 40 years of expertise, specialising in wind turbine design
and development.

[ Explore our onshore wind turbine solutions ][144]
[ [Offshore wind turbines] ][145]

##### Offshore wind turbines

We have an unrivalled track record of making wind work at sea, bringing offshore wind to life in
even the most challenging environments.

[ Explore our offshore wind turbine solutions ][146]
[ [Service] ][147]

##### Service

We maintain the world's largest wind turbine fleet, spanning over 56,000 turbines across 72
countries.

[ Explore our service solutions ][148]
[ [Development] ][149]

##### Development

We turn renewable energy visions into reality by developing high-quality renewable energy projects
with value.

[ Explore our project development solutions ][150]

At Vestas, technology leadership means delivering lasting value. Through scalable, reliable, and
sustainable solutions, we deliver long-term value for customers and society - strengthening energy
systems and accelerating the transition to a more secure and sustainable future.

We're on a mission to transform the global energy system. With a dedicated team of +35,000
employees, we work every day to shape a more sustainable future by designing, installing, and
maintaining wind energy projects worldwide.

We believe wind power will form the backbone of tomorrow’s energy system. That's why we're steadfast
in our commitment to solutions that drive the vital transition to renewable energy, with wind at the
core.

RWE Americas, a subsidiary of RWE, is a US-based energy company that is helping to meet the growing
demand for energy across the United States. Backed by RWE’s 125-year global legacy of managing
diverse power assets, RWE Americas operates approximately 13 GW of power projects across 27 states. 
With a talented workforce of 2,000 employees, RWE Americas develops, constructs and operates wind,
solar and battery storage projects, along with natural gas-powered generation, that safely delivers
affordable, reliable electricity to our customers.

[Solar panels in the foreground with wind turbines on a hillside under a bright sky, showcasing
renewable energy sources.]
**RWE Americas **is developing, building and operating homegrown and fastest-to-market generation
solutions, while supporting American economic growth and energy security.  RWE is committed to
responsible development, investing in local and rural communities, creating jobs and partnering with
stakeholders to support and strengthen the places where we live and work.
[Read more][61]
[A wind farm with several turbines on stilts in the ocean under a cloudy sky.]

**RWE Offshore Wind GmbH** is a global energy company for sustainable electricity generation based
on offshore wind power. The company’s international focus is on Europe, USA and selected markets in
Asia. Over the past 20 years, RWE has developed unique expertise in the offshore industry, as its 18
operating wind farms demonstrate.

[Read more on rwe.com][62]
[Aerial view of New York City's skyline showcasing tall skyscrapers and green spaces under a clear
blue sky.]

**RWE Trading Americas Inc.** (“RWETA”) represents a local connection to the North American energy
markets for RWE Supply & Trading GmbH. Based in New York City, an important hub for major energy
investors, traders, brokers, and policy drivers, RWETA’s activities primarily focus on the
management of existing and origination of new RWE Energy Transition Investments.

[Read more][63]

### We are leading the way to a modern energy world – with an extensive investment and growth
### strategy.

Data networks, mobility, industry, infrastructure, businesses, family: We all need energy. Society
is facing a major task as a result: meeting a growing need for electricity while protecting the
climate. RWE is one of the leading companies in the field of renewable energy. RWE is investing
billions of euros in expanding its generation portfolio, in particular in offshore and onshore wind,
solar energy and batteries. It is perfectly complemented by its global energy trading business.
Thanks to its integrated portfolio of renewables, battery storage and flexible generation, as well
as its broad project pipeline of possible new builds, RWE is well positioned to address the growing
global demand for electricity, particularly driving by further electrification and artificial
intelligence.

RWE Supply & Trading provides tailored energy solutions for large customers. RWE has locations in
the attractive markets of Europe, North America and the Asia-Pacific region. The company is
responsibly phasing out coal by 2030. RWE employs around 20,000 people worldwide and has a clear
target: to get to net zero by 2040. On its way there, the company has set itself ambitious targets
for all activities that cause greenhouse gas emissions. The Science Based Targets initiative has
confirmed that these emission reduction targets are in line with the Paris Agreement. Very much in
the spirit of the company’s purpose:

**Our energy for a sustainable life.**

  ### Der BWO
  
  Der BWO ist die politische Interessenvertretung der Offshore-Wind-Branche in Deutschland. Wir
  bündeln die fachliche Expertise der Unternehmen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette, von den
  Herstellern über die Entwickler und Betreiber bis hin zu den Dienstleistern der
  Offshore-Windenergie. Der BWO setzt sich dafür ein, die politischen, regulatorischen und
  ökonomischen **Rahmenbedingungen** für den Ausbau der Offshore-Windenergie im Sinne der
  Energiewende zu **verbessern**. Der BWO ist für politische Akteure auf Landes- und Bundesebene
  zentraler Ansprechpartner zu allen Fragen der Windenergie auf See. Der BWO wertet aktuelle
  Entwicklungen aus und analysiert die Folgen künftiger regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen.

  ### Der BWO
  
  Der BWO ist die politische Interessenvertretung der Offshore-Wind-Branche in Deutschland. Wir
  bündeln die fachliche Expertise der Unternehmen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette, von den
  Herstellern über die Entwickler und Betreiber bis hin zu den Dienstleistern der
  Offshore-Windenergie. Der BWO setzt sich dafür ein, die politischen, regulatorischen und
  ökonomischen **Rahmenbedingungen** für den Ausbau der Offshore-Windenergie im Sinne der
  Energiewende zu **verbessern**. Der BWO ist für politische Akteure auf Landes- und Bundesebene
  zentraler Ansprechpartner zu allen Fragen der Windenergie auf See. Der BWO wertet aktuelle
  Entwicklungen aus und analysiert die Folgen künftiger regulatorischer Rahmenbedingungen.

Baltic Power Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
Poland

In July of 2025, Cadeler successfully completed the installation of the very first Vestas 15MW
turbine at the Baltic Power Offshore Wind Farm in the Baltic Sea - marking the beginning of another
significant wind farm project. Over the coming months, Cadeler’s Wind Osprey and her crew will carry
out the transport and installation of all the 76 offshore wind turbines from the Port of Rønne in
Bornholm, Denmark. When fully commissioned next year, the 1.2 GW wind farm will become Poland’s
first offshore wind farm, powering over 1.5 million Polish households, covering 3% of the country’s
electricity demand, and estimated to save 2.8 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions every year.

[ Learn More ][42]

Sofia Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
United Kingdom

The 1.4 GW Sofia Offshore Wind Farm is developed by RWE and will be one of the largest single
offshore wind farms in the world. Cadeler's Wind Peak will assist Siemens Gamesa with the transport
and installation of 100 of the impressive 14MW WTGs. Half of them will be fitted with recyclable
blades from Siemens Gamesa’s blade manufacturing facility in Hull. Not only setting new standards
for sustainability, but also supporting jobs in coastal communities. When completed, the wind farm
will provide almost 1.2 million UK homes with their annual electricity needs. This means, more than
2.5 million tonnes of carbon emissions per year will be saved.

Poland

In July of 2025, Cadeler successfully completed the installation of the very first Vestas 15MW
turbine at the Baltic Power Offshore Wind Farm in the Baltic Sea - marking the beginning of another
significant wind farm project. Over the coming months, Cadeler’s Wind Osprey and her crew will carry
out the transport and installation of all the 76 offshore wind turbines from the Port of Rønne in
Bornholm, Denmark. When fully commissioned next year, the 1.2 GW wind farm will become Poland’s
first offshore wind farm, powering over 1.5 million Polish households, covering 3% of the country’s
electricity demand, and estimated to save 2.8 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions every year.

Sofia Offshore Wind Farm
WTG Installation
United Kingdom

The 1.4 GW Sofia Offshore Wind Farm is developed by RWE and will be one of the largest single
offshore wind farms in the world. Cadeler's Wind Peak will assist Siemens Gamesa with the transport
and installation of 100 of the impressive 14MW WTGs. Half of them will be fitted with recyclable
blades from Siemens Gamesa’s blade manufacturing facility in Hull. Not only setting new standards
for sustainability, but also supporting jobs in coastal communities. When completed, the wind farm
will provide almost 1.2 million UK homes with their annual electricity needs. This means, more than
2.5 million tonnes of carbon emissions per year will be saved.

# We're looking for innovators to work with us

As bp embarks on the most ambitious challenge in our 114-year history - our transformation from
international oil company (IOC) to integrated energy company (IEC) - we’re looking for technological
and commercial partners in a wide range of industries, sectors and specialisms.

[ See our collaboration hubs ][12]

##### Making changes for a better world

### How you can engage with us

Below you will find links to business unit collaboration hubs and live innovation campaigns. The
collaboration hubs are always on spaces where you can share your innovative products and services
with relevant teams within bp. Submissions to the collaboration hubs are regularly vetted and then
shared with relevant stakeholders within the businesses. Live innovation campaigns, time bound
searches for products and services to meet specific challenges bp are looking to overcome, feature a
brief of what we’re looking for, launch dates and submission deadlines.

### Reasons to work with us

How we can achieve our ambitions for people and the planet

#### Acceleration

You gain access to new customers, project revenue, and a streamlined collaboration process.

#### Co-creation

You can refine and scale your solution through real-world integration, while we benefit from rapid
technology deployments that solve specific business challenges.

#### Simplification

We both enjoy a transparent, standardised way of working that reduces administrative hurdles and
shortens the path to collaboration.

##### Be part of the change

### Our collaboration hubs

### Production & operations

In production & operations (P&O) our vision is to become an industry-leading hydrocarbons business
and the engine room of our integrated energy company. We will do this by always putting safety
first, reducing carbon emissions, improving efficiency, integrating across the value chain, and
flexibly deploying talent to the solve the biggest issues.

[ Learn more ][13]

### Customers & products

In customers & products (C&P), we’re a set of global and regional businesses serving millions of
diverse customers every day. We power our customers’ journeys whether they need fuel or a charge for
the road, lubricants products to keep engines moving or a convenient coffee and snack to recharge
themselves.

[ Learn more ][14]

### Supply, trading & shipping

Our ambition is to be the world's leading energy marketing, operations, and trading team. We are
always striving for more innovative digital solutions, sustainable outcomes and closer collaboration
across bp and beyond.

[ Learn more ][15]

### Gas & low carbon energy

Gas & low carbon energy (G&LCE) encompasses businesses helping to advance bp’s strategic
transformation from an international oil company to an integrated energy company.

[ Learn more ][16]

### Health, safety, environment & carbon

bp makes the safety and reliability of all of its operations our top priority. By focusing on
developing engineering and control systems that reduce hazards and support compliance, capability
and performance, we look to ensure all our people are safe and secure in the environment they work
in.

[ Learn more ][17]

### Open collaboration

If your business has technology that you think can help bp, but doesn't fit into one of our
business-driven campaigns, please share you details here!

[ Learn more ][18]

shortlisted applicants.

comment, one of our team will receive notification and we'll get back to you ASAP.

Yes. You can always go into the platform and upload refreshed/new documentation. In fact, we
encourage you to do this, especially if your technology has evolved significantly since your
original submission. Please keep in mind that only non-confidential information should be uploaded.

# Propelling Renewable Energy Forward

Providing reliable, affordable and increasingly clean energy that powers your every day.

[View Project Timeline][26]

[Pause][27]

### Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind

## Our Clean Energy Future

Construction on Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind (CVOW), the largest offshore wind project in the
United States, is progressing on schedule. Onshore construction for transmission infrastructure
began in late 2023, and offshore construction commenced in early 2024.

Anchored in Hampton Roads, CVOW is transforming the local economy and beyond by attracting economic
development opportunities to create hundreds of good-paying clean energy jobs, millions in tax
revenues and hundreds of millions in economic benefits annually.

Once complete, CVOW will generate enough energy to power up to 660,000 homes, and it will add to our
diverse energy mix, which is essential for energy security, reliability and lowering fuel costs.
* [Turbine Icon]
  
  #### 176 offshore wind turbines
* [Houses Icon]
  
  #### 660,000 homes powered
* [Timeline Icon]
  
  #### 2027 expected completion

[One spinning offshore wind turbine]

## Resources

Explore our full library of project resources for additional information on the project, the
transmission route, environmental mitigation and more.

[Find Resources][28]

### About

[Wrench Icon] The Project
[Lightbulb with money icon] Economic Benefits
[Whale Tail icon] Environmental Stewardship

## Delivering on Our Mission

We are committed to safely providing an all-of-the-above mix of power generation sources to meet
rising power demand, including offshore wind, to provide our customers with reliable, affordable and
increasingly clean energy.

CVOW is a 2.6-gigawatt project. Its 176 offshore wind turbines will generate enough carbon-free,
renewable energy to power up to 660,000 homes. Harnessing the power of the wind means this project
has expected fuel savings of $3 billion for customers during the project's first decade of
operations.

[Learn more about the CVOW project][29]

[Monopile installation in the CVOW lease area, and a wind turbine in the background.]

## Jobs for Today and Tomorrow

More than 800 Virginia-based workers are engaged on the project or with other businesses supporting
CVOW. To support ongoing operations and maintenance, more than 1,000 local jobs will be needed.

[Learn more about job creation][30]

[A bright yellow safety vest with the Dominion Energy logo hangs on the ship, with monopile
installation in the background]

## Protecting What Matters

We are committed to meeting the energy needs of our customers in an environmentally conscious
manner. Protecting natural and cultural resources is our duty as a responsible corporate citizen.

This is why we are taking extensive precautions to safeguard sensitive marine species, like the
North Atlantic right whale.

[Learn more about our efforts][31]

[Fish explore the artificial reef created at the base of the CVOW turbines]

### Community

## Maritime

Learn about monthly offshore operations updates.

[Read Updates][32]

## Fishing

We recognize that commercial fishing and the CVOW projects share a common ocean.

[Read About Our Commitment][33]

## Residents

Learn more about onshore construction work for transmission.

[Read About Our Progress][34]

Dominion Energy’s major Coastal Virginia Offshore Wind project is now sending surges of power to the
grid, after its first commercial turbine was switched on Monday. It is the largest offshore wind
project in America.

[View][35]

With the certainty that state oversight and the Clean Economy Act gave, Dominion was able to nail
down firm contracts from suppliers. “The fact that we have a regulated project, and the fact that
the Clean Economy Act set those targets, gave us the confidence to go to the vendors and say this is
what we need on this schedule,” said Bob Blue, Dominion Energy's chair, president and chief
executive officer.

## [A proposed moratorium on data centers hits resistance in Mass. Senate][78]

# Everllence - Moving big things to zero

[ Learn more about our new name ][162]

What we do

## We provide decarbonization technologies for global shipping, energy generation, and industry

Shipping, power generation, and heavy industry produce nearly a third of the world’s carbon
emissions. These are the hardest sectors to decarbonize and the most essential to keep running.
Energy infrastructure operates at massive scale and is tightly interwoven with global supply chains.
Transforming it is complex – but it must start now. This is exactly where we come in. We develop the
technologies that make decarbonization practical and economical for the industries the world depends
on. From the engines that power global trade to the heat pumps that warm entire cities.

## Reliable partners in renewable energy

With experience across **40+ countries**, a [global team][35] of over **2,200 people**, and a strong
international supply chain, FairWind supports [customers’ wind projects worldwide.][36]

Since 2008, we’ve grown both organically and through [strategic acquisitions][37], expanding our
geographic reach and diversifying our services to accelerate the **global energy transition**. We’re
proud to deliver solutions that create a **sustainable future** and a better world for generations
to come.

[ About FairWind ][38]

## Our offerings

With nearly two decades of experience in the renewable energy sector, FairWind delivers specialist
services across the full lifecycle of wind turbine operations. Our expert technicians support
onshore and offshore wind projects worldwide, helping developers, OEMs, and asset owners install,
maintain, and optimise their assets safely and efficiently.

Installation & Preassembly

FairWind supports wind farm construction with experienced technical teams delivering turbine
[installation and preassembly][39] services. Our specialists ensure turbines are assembled safely,
efficiently, and to the highest quality standards, supporting projects from early construction
through to commissioning.

Operations & Maintenance

Our preventive and corrective [maintenance services][40] help wind turbines operate reliably and
efficiently throughout their operational life. By identifying issues early and responding quickly
when faults occur, we help minimise downtime and maximise energy production.

Decommissioning & Repowering

As wind farms reach the end of their operational life, FairWind supports customers with safe,
efficient [decommissioning and repowering][41] solutions. Our experienced teams manage turbine
dismantling, component removal, and site restoration, ensuring compliance with [environmental and
safety standards][42]. We also support repowering projects by preparing sites for next-generation
turbines, helping customers extend the value and performance of their wind assets.

Training & Workforce Development

Through the [European Wind Academy][43], FairWind provides specialised training programmes for wind
industry technicians. Our training focuses on safety, technical skills, and industry best practices,
helping develop a highly skilled workforce capable of supporting modern wind turbine technology both
onshore and offshore.

Global Technical Expertise

With highly trained technicians and international project experience, FairWind provides flexible
technical support wherever wind farms operate. Our [teams][44] integrate seamlessly with client
operations to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient service worldwide.

## Global presence

FairWind operates globally, combining local expertise with world-class standards. Through strategic
partnerships with Cosmic in APAC and the European Wind Academy in Europe and Australia, we
strengthen our presence and drive excellence across all regions.

Cosmic Group

In partnership with [Cosmic][45], FairWind can combine local expertise with alignment to its global
systems, standards, and strategic vision. This business serves as the regional hub for FairWind’s
APAC operations.

Rope Partner

[Rope Partner ][46]is a US-based leader in at-height wind turbine maintenance and SPRAT-certified
technician training, strengthening FairWind’s service capability and presence across the Americas.

European Wind Academy

The [European Wind Academy][47] empowers professionals with cutting-edge skills and knowledge, while
ensuring alignment with FairWind’s global standards and strategic vision. It also serves as the
central hub for developing talent across FairWind’s operations.

## Reliable partners in renewable energy

With experience across **40+ countries**, a [global team][35] of over **2,200 people**, and a strong
international supply chain, FairWind supports [customers’ wind projects worldwide.][36]

Since 2008, we’ve grown both organically and through [strategic acquisitions][37], expanding our
geographic reach and diversifying our services to accelerate the **global energy transition**. We’re
proud to deliver solutions that create a **sustainable future** and a better world for generations
to come.

[ About FairWind ][38]

## Our offerings

With nearly two decades of experience in the renewable energy sector, FairWind delivers specialist
services across the full lifecycle of wind turbine operations. Our expert technicians support
onshore and offshore wind projects worldwide, helping developers, OEMs, and asset owners install,
maintain, and optimise their assets safely and efficiently.

Installation & Preassembly

FairWind supports wind farm construction with experienced technical teams delivering turbine
[installation and preassembly][39] services. Our specialists ensure turbines are assembled safely,
efficiently, and to the highest quality standards, supporting projects from early construction
through to commissioning.

Operations & Maintenance

Our preventive and corrective [maintenance services][40] help wind turbines operate reliably and
efficiently throughout their operational life. By identifying issues early and responding quickly
when faults occur, we help minimise downtime and maximise energy production.

Decommissioning & Repowering

As wind farms reach the end of their operational life, FairWind supports customers with safe,
efficient [decommissioning and repowering][41] solutions. Our experienced teams manage turbine
dismantling, component removal, and site restoration, ensuring compliance with [environmental and
safety standards][42]. We also support repowering projects by preparing sites for next-generation
turbines, helping customers extend the value and performance of their wind assets.

Training & Workforce Development

Through the [European Wind Academy][43], FairWind provides specialised training programmes for wind
industry technicians. Our training focuses on safety, technical skills, and industry best practices,
helping develop a highly skilled workforce capable of supporting modern wind turbine technology both
onshore and offshore.

Global Technical Expertise

With highly trained technicians and international project experience, FairWind provides flexible
technical support wherever wind farms operate. Our [teams][44] integrate seamlessly with client
operations to deliver safe, reliable, and efficient service worldwide.

## Global presence

FairWind operates globally, combining local expertise with world-class standards. Through strategic
partnerships with Cosmic in APAC and the European Wind Academy in Europe and Australia, we
strengthen our presence and drive excellence across all regions.

Cosmic Group

In partnership with [Cosmic][45], FairWind can combine local expertise with alignment to its global
systems, standards, and strategic vision. This business serves as the regional hub for FairWind’s
APAC operations.

Rope Partner

[Rope Partner ][46]is a US-based leader in at-height wind turbine maintenance and SPRAT-certified
technician training, strengthening FairWind’s service capability and presence across the Americas.

European Wind Academy

The [European Wind Academy][47] empowers professionals with cutting-edge skills and knowledge, while
ensuring alignment with FairWind’s global standards and strategic vision. It also serves as the
central hub for developing talent across FairWind’s operations.

# How to store electricity?

Electricity can be stored in several ways: electrochemical, mechanical, electromagnetic, biological,
thermal, and chemical. **How to store electricity from renewable energy sources** is a massive
problem. I am sure you have seen one of energy storage types, such as batteries, pumped hydro energy
storage, gravity energy storage, compressed air energy storage or hydrogen storage.

You use power banks, batteries in a mobile phone, or laptop, **stored energy can be used later**
when you need it!

The most popular way to store energy are batteries, leading electrochemical technologies are LFP
(LiFePO4), Li-Ion, Lead-Acid, NiMH, NCA, LMO, LCO, NMC, LTO and many more [battery types][8].

Learn more about **[energy storage][9] from the practical point of view**, read my blog now.

*Kamil Talar, Msc.*

## Discover IREC

Learn who we are and how our research drives innovation in sustainable energy.

[See more][165]

## Who we are

IREC is a public research centre within the CERCA system, founded in 2008 and dedicated to research,
development, innovation and demonstration in sustainable energy.

Our work spans the full scope of the energy transition, from fundamental science to applied
research, with the aim of generating knowledge that is relevant to industry, public administrations
and society. Through collaboration with research groups, institutions and companies, we help drive
the energy transition and strengthen the role of science in building a cleaner and more resilient
future.

## Who we are

IREC is a public research centre within the CERCA system, founded in 2008 and dedicated to research,
development, innovation and demonstration in sustainable energy.

Our work spans the full scope of the energy transition, from fundamental science to applied
research, with the aim of generating knowledge that is relevant to industry, public administrations
and society. Through collaboration with research groups, institutions and companies, we help drive
the energy transition and strengthen the role of science in building a cleaner and more resilient
future.

# Innovative Solutions For
# **A Sustainable Future**

NMDC Group is an integrated energy and marine services, engineering, procurement, and construction
(EPC) organization with a footprint spanning the MENA region, South Asia, and beyond. We work on
highly ambitious projects, delivering innovative solutions to even the most complex challenges.

[ About Us ][40]

## About NMDC Group

NMDC Group is a prominent figure in the fields of engineering, marine dredging, procurement, and
construction, working in the Middle East and further afield.

We specialize in providing innovative solutions for those vital sectors at the core of the UAE
economy. This includes addressing the complex future challenges facing the energy EPC sector.

Under our umbrella, we own and operate five business units: NMDC Dredging & Marine, NMDC Energy,
NMDC Infra, NMDC Engineering, and NMDC LTS.

[ Read More About NMDC Group ][41]

## Business Units

### NMDC Dredging & Marine

Leading the field of marine dredging, reclamation, and construction, NMDC Dredging & Marine delivers
projects of superior quality. With years of international experience, we are known for our
exceptional track record and commitment to generating true value for all stakeholders.

[ Visit Website ][42]

### NMDC Energy

NMDC Energy is focused on providing engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) solutions to
the energy sector. With comprehensive services tailored to both offshore and onshore clients in the
oil & gas and energy industries, NMDC Energy is designed to continuously meet the industry’s
challenges.

[ Visit Website ][43]

### NMDC Engineering

A leading coastal and marine engineering consultancy, NMDC Engineering has experience working across
marine, civil, hydraulics, geotechnical, and environmental engineering. Across the Arabian Gulf and
the Middle East, NMDC Engineering is enabling the completion of some of the largest marine,
waterfront, and oil & gas infrastructure.

[ Visit Website ][44]

### NMDC Infra

A pioneering construction technology business, NMDC Infra is leading the way when it comes to
precast concrete. With cutting-edge technology and extensive experience, we offer complete,
sustainable, and affordable precast solutions for all construction products, delivering a wide range
of structural and architectural elements.

[ Visit Website ][45]

### NMDC LTS

NMDC LTS (NMDC Logistics & Technical Services) delivers industry-leading support for complex
infrastructure projects, leveraging decades of EPC expertise to ensure seamless execution. With a
solution-driven approach, we drive operational excellence and efficiency across the construction and
industrial sectors, facilitating sustainable growth.

# Innovative Solutions For
# **A Sustainable Future**

NMDC Group is an integrated energy and marine services, engineering, procurement, and construction
(EPC) organization with a footprint spanning the MENA region, South Asia, and beyond. We work on
highly ambitious projects, delivering innovative solutions to even the most complex challenges.

[ About Us ][40]

## About NMDC Group

NMDC Group is a prominent figure in the fields of engineering, marine dredging, procurement, and
construction, working in the Middle East and further afield.

We specialize in providing innovative solutions for those vital sectors at the core of the UAE
economy. This includes addressing the complex future challenges facing the energy EPC sector.

Under our umbrella, we own and operate five business units: NMDC Dredging & Marine, NMDC Energy,
NMDC Infra, NMDC Engineering, and NMDC LTS.

[ Read More About NMDC Group ][41]

## Business Units

### NMDC Dredging & Marine

Leading the field of marine dredging, reclamation, and construction, NMDC Dredging & Marine delivers
projects of superior quality. With years of international experience, we are known for our
exceptional track record and commitment to generating true value for all stakeholders.

[ Visit Website ][42]

### NMDC Energy

NMDC Energy is focused on providing engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) solutions to
the energy sector. With comprehensive services tailored to both offshore and onshore clients in the
oil & gas and energy industries, NMDC Energy is designed to continuously meet the industry’s
challenges.

[ Visit Website ][43]

### NMDC Engineering

A leading coastal and marine engineering consultancy, NMDC Engineering has experience working across
marine, civil, hydraulics, geotechnical, and environmental engineering. Across the Arabian Gulf and
the Middle East, NMDC Engineering is enabling the completion of some of the largest marine,
waterfront, and oil & gas infrastructure.

[ Visit Website ][44]

### NMDC Infra

A pioneering construction technology business, NMDC Infra is leading the way when it comes to
precast concrete. With cutting-edge technology and extensive experience, we offer complete,
sustainable, and affordable precast solutions for all construction products, delivering a wide range
of structural and architectural elements.

[ Visit Website ][45]

### NMDC LTS

NMDC LTS (NMDC Logistics & Technical Services) delivers industry-leading support for complex
infrastructure projects, leveraging decades of EPC expertise to ensure seamless execution. With a
solution-driven approach, we drive operational excellence and efficiency across the construction and
industrial sectors, facilitating sustainable growth.

About

## Norwegian Offshore Wind

Our goal is to establish world leading supply chains within offshore wind. With ~300 members ranging
from agile startups to large offshore wind developers, we are the biggest industry network in
Norway.

[Read more][33]

## Join our newsletter

Get weekly updates from the industry and other Norwegian Offshore Wind content

[Sign up here][34]

We care about your data in our [privacy policy][35].

## Markets

We influence policy and political processes on the projects in Norway. We help our members to gain
access and succeed in the key offshore wind markets, especially within floating wind.

## Innovation

Through collaboration, we drive innovation forward to bring costs down. 

## Supply chain

We aim to build a world leading supply chain within floating offshore wind.

## Ausbauziele Offshore-Windenergie

Die Ausbauziele für die Offshore-Windenergie im Windenergie-auf-See-Gesetz (WindSeeG) sehen vor,
dass die installierte Leistung von Offshore-Windenergieanlagen am Netz bis zum Jahr 2030 auf
insgesamt mindestens 30 GW, bis zum Jahr 2035 auf mindestens 40 GW und bis zum Jahr 2045 auf
mindestens 70 GW gesteigert wird.
Zur Erreichung der Ausbauziele, trifft das Bundes-amt für Seeschifffahrt und Hydrographie (BSH) im
Flächenentwicklungsplan (FEP) fortlaufend neue Festlegungen zum künftigen Ausbau, ins-besondere zu
den Windenergieflächen und den zugehörigen Netzanbindungen, den Kalender-jahren der Ausschreibungen
und vorgesehenen Inbetriebnahmen. Der FEP

2025 wurde im Januar 2025 veröffentlicht, im Januar 2026 folgte die erste Änderung und im Juni 2026
der Entwurf zur zweiten Änderung. Die erste Änderung legte die Verschiebung der Ausschreibungen und
Inbe-triebnahmen einiger Flächen und Netzan-bindungen fest. Der Entwurf zur zweiten Änderung sieht
weitere Verschiebungen und auch die Streichung von Ausschreibungen vor.

APPROACHING THE FUTURE

Empowering the Future with Wind

Wind Energy Solutions

Offshore Wind Power Consulting, based in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, is a highly experienced company
in the wind energy sector. They offer guidance and effective management practices, drawing from a
skilled team and a wealth of industry knowledge. Their active involvement in offshore wind farm
management, construction, and maintenance sets them apart as a trusted partner in the field.

About us

Offshore Wind Power Consulting is a dynamic company with years of experience in the wind energy
sector. Based in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, we provide expert guidance and management, ensuring
informed operational and business decisions. As part of an experienced industry group, we leverage
extensive resources and insights to enhance the quality and range of services for our clients.

OUR STRENGTH

Project Development

Including the Project Execution Plan, preparation of ITTs, contract strategies and planning of the
design, fabrication and construction stages.

Tender and contract negotiation

Evaluation of tenders and contract negotiation, including main contractors, subcontractors, vessels,
etc.

Windfarm construction

Supply of Key resources in the organisation structure, set up of interfaces between contractors,
creation of procedures and processes.

Commissioning & Testing

Training of offshore teams, creation of procedures, vessel manifests, work orders, etc. Marine
coordination services including permit to work management.

Operations And Maintenance

Practical support to meet the requirements of the operations and maintenance regime for an offshore
wind farm. This includes vessel sourcing, QHSE Management, Site management, offshore supervision and
component exchange.

Global Wind Energy Expertise

Onshore & Offshore Solutions Tailored to Your Project Needs

With over two decades of experience, our team has been involved in the successful execution of 26+
offshore wind farms worldwide. We provide end-to-end solutions in collaboration with leading WTG
manufacturers, covering.

APPROACHING THE FUTURE

Empowering the Future with Wind

Wind Energy Solutions

Offshore Wind Power Consulting, based in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, is a highly experienced company
in the wind energy sector. They offer guidance and effective management practices, drawing from a
skilled team and a wealth of industry knowledge. Their active involvement in offshore wind farm
management, construction, and maintenance sets them apart as a trusted partner in the field.

About us

Offshore Wind Power Consulting is a dynamic company with years of experience in the wind energy
sector. Based in Palma de Mallorca, Spain, we provide expert guidance and management, ensuring
informed operational and business decisions. As part of an experienced industry group, we leverage
extensive resources and insights to enhance the quality and range of services for our clients.

Project Development

design, fabrication and construction stages.

coordination services including permit to work management.

Operations And Maintenance

Practical support to meet the requirements of the operations and maintenance regime for an offshore
wind farm. This includes vessel sourcing, QHSE Management, Site management, offshore supervision and
component exchange.

## Power into German Grid][26]

**Jul 22, 2026 17:05** | Essen — RWE's Nordseecluster A offshore wind project has reached another
milestone. About six weeks after installing its first wind turbine, a turbine has fed electricity
into the German transmission grid for the first time. The first construction phase of the offshore
wind farm, with a capacity of 660 MW, is scheduled to be fully operational in early 2027. [read
more...][27]

## Largest-Ever PPA with Ørsted][28]

has contracted overall, the ongoing energy crisis and continued market volatility are pushing Good
Energy to rely increasingly on large, long-term electricity supply contracts to secure supply.
Against this backdrop, the British green energy supplier and Danish offshore wind group Ørsted have
significantly expanded their supply relationship. [read more...][29]

expansion of its wind energy portfolio in Germany, backed by a series of permits granted under the
Federal Immission Control Act (BImSchG) in the first half of 2026. [read more...][31]

O.S. Energy

# Enabling Offshore Wind to Push Our World Forward.

O.S. Energy supports your offshore project with specialised multi-purpose offshore vessels, a wide
range of services, and a dedicated back office team. Our customized solutions combine
state-of-the-art technology, top-level expertise, and over 20 years of experience.
[Our Services][9][Meet our fleet][10]

Who we work for

## Turning Offshore Challenges Into Reliable Solutions.

O.S. Energy is a trusted and experienced shipping partner for offshore wind park owners, operators,
private and public enterprises, as well as researchers and institutions.

[Find out more][11]

What we do

## We Get the
## Job Done.

O.S. Energy provides specially equipped vessels for all tasks around your offshore project. This
includes state-of-the-art equipment and installations of all sizes. We are your reliable partner
from start to finish – and beyond. Offshore, but never offline.
[Discover our services][12]
[Crew performing maintenance on O.S. Energy service vessel deck in North Sea]

### Let’s Keep the Future Afloat. Together.

Offshore to the core: At O.S. Energy, we work hard to provide the ideal support for your project. No
matter how specific and uncommon your need – we will find the ideal solution.
[See vessels][13][Careers at OSE][14]

Safety and Health

## Safety and Health:
## Always on Course.

Safety and health are the foundation: At O.S. Energy, we fulfill, and often exceed, the strictest
international standards. Through regular training, modern equipment, and proactive risk management,
we ensure the safety of our crew, clients and partners. We are also dedicated to safeguarding the
environment during everything we do.
[About O.S. Energy][15]
[O.S. Energy multipurpose service vessels fleet at sea in North Sea operations]

Our vessels for you

## A Fleet for
## Every Need.

Our versatile vessels are built to handle any challenge. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, they
meet the diverse and demanding needs of the offshore industry. We help you succeed, even in the most
challenging conditions.
[Discover Our Fleet][16]

Our services

## Reliable Offshore
## Services for You.

With over 20 years of experience and a rigorous focus on quality, precision and reliability, we
deliver specialised offshore solutions that will help you overcome any challenge. Highly skilled and
experienced crews, a versatile fleet, and strict safety measures ensure the best possible service
for your project.

### Offshore Services & Operations

Always the most suitable service vessel, precisely modified to fit your specific demands.

### Shipmanagement

Integrated vessel management services as single components or as a full package service.

### Consulting & Customised Service Solutions

Our in-house marine and technical engineering team safely modifies vessels, designs customised
equipment, and provides valuable consultancy services.

[O.S. Energy multipurpose service vessels fleet at sea in North Sea operations]
[Crew performing maintenance on O.S. Energy service vessel deck in North Sea]

## “O.S. Energy has grown alongside the offshore wind industry, approaching every new project as an
## opportunity to learn, expand our expertise, enhance our skills, and improve our services. This
## has allowed our clients to save enormous costs and effort.”

Vincent Nürnberg

Working at O.S.E

## Let the Wind of (Career) Change Guide You.

Ready to embark on an extraordinary career journey? Willing to work at the forefront of the energy
transition and shape the future? Join O.S. Energy! You’ll take on responsibility early and work in
an exciting international environment. Whether onshore or at sea, at our headquarter in Glückstadt,
Germany, or in our offices in Denmark and the UK, we offer flexibility and room for professional and
personal growth. We are always looking for motivated new colleagues and also offer vocational
training to become a shipping merchant.

# The Renewable Energy Consultants

The Renewable Energy Consultants.

OWC combines a legacy in offshore wind, multi-disciplinary engineering expertise and market
experience across renewable energies offshore and onshore, to support the commercial development of
wind power, solar PV, hydrogen and energy storage solutions with the most comprehensive technical
offering in engineering, consultancy and advisory.

## Dedicated renewable energy consultants, from concept to operations

OWC has worked with clients on wind power projects since 2011, but as a multi-disciplinary renewable
energy consultancy, we’re equipped to deliver results across a wide range of sectors. If there is an
emerging renewable energy market, we’ll be there to help you develop a strategy and achieve
consistent results.

**Discover our experience across the sectors**

[[Wind Consultancy]][64]

### [Wind Consultancy][65]

We work with you at every stage of a windfarm project’s lifecycle. With 330+ successful projects,
we’ll support you every step of the way.
[Find out more ][66]
[[Solar PV]][67]

### [Solar PV][68]

Solar-powered renewables are the fastest-growing renewable technology. With over 20 experts around
the world, we can help you to succeed in this high-demand sector.
[Find out more ][69]
[[Photo of energy storage equipment]][70]

### [Energy Storage][71]

Our veteran renewable energy consultants can work on individual battery energy storage systems
(BESS), or joint-market projects requiring specialist technical insight.

### [Wave and Tidal Engineering Consultants][74]

Through our sister company INNOSEA, OWC will work with you on technical, advisory, engineering and
marine assurance services to support the development of ocean energy technologies.
[Find out more ][75]
[[Floating Solar]][76]

### [Floating Solar][77]

Floating photovoltaic (FPV) technology is still in its infancy, so our dedicated renewable energy
consultants can work with you to provide market-leading support for your project.
[Find out more ][78]
[[Hydrogen]][79]

### [Hydrogen][80]

With hydrogen considered a cornerstone of the global energy transition, we’ll work with you on full
life-cycle projects across production, storage, and transportation.

* [Cable Laying Services][75]
  Cable Laying Services
  
  **Seaway7 offers submarine cable- and subsea umbilical installation, repair and maintenance
  services.**
  
  Related services such as dive and Remote Operated Vehicle (ROV) support, marine survey, Unexploded
  Ordnance (UXO) investigation and remedial cable protection services are also provided.
  
  [Read More][76]
* [WTG Foundations][77]
  WTG Foundations
  
  **Seaway7 offers installation services for WTG foundations utilising their ground-breaking custom
  built foundation installation vessel Seaway Alfa Lift as well as their established Heavy Lift
  Vessels (HLV), *Seaway Strashnov* and *Seaway Alfa Lift*.**
  
  In the last 12 years Seaway7 has built up an extensive track record in installing a wide range of
  foundation types, ranging from monopiles and suction bucket jackets to tripod and pre-piled
  jackets using a pile installation frame.
  
  [Read More][78]
* [Offshore Substations][79]
  Offshore Substations
  
  **Using our Heavy Lift Vessels, Seaway7 can provide the transportation and installation of
  offshore substation jackets and topsides. Mid 2020, we had successfully installed more than 30
  HVAC platforms.**
  
  The DP3 HLV *Seaway Strashnov* with its 5000t crane is especially well equipped for this work.

## energy system

The world is 1.1 °C warmer today than in pre-industrial times, and although the COVID-19 pandemic
has caused a decrease in CO2 emissions, global warming remains on the wrong trajectory. According to
the Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, a 1.5 °C increase in global average surface
temperature will have devastating consequences for our planet, causing extreme weather events,
rising sea levels, and climatic changes. The temperature increase is largely caused by the growing
concentration of CO2 in the atmosphere, and energy production and usage remain the primary emitter.
It is therefore abundantly clear that urgent change is needed in the world’s energy mix. For
instance, according to the International Energy Agency, a 40 percent reduction in emissions by 2030
will require nearly 75 percent of global electricity generation to come from low-emission sources by
this time.

To change our planet’s trajectory, the most cost-effective and immediate path to meaningful
emissions reduction is large-scale deployment of renewable energy. However, as the penetration of
renewable electricity increases, this alone will not be enough to avoid a temperature increase above
1.5 °C. We must therefore address the following three challenges:

### Accelerate the deployment of renewable energy

Wind and solar energy only account for around 9 percent of the global electricity generation mix
today;⁶ it is therefore clear that the deployment of renewables needs to accelerate substantially
for the world to stay within a 1.5 °C scenario.

### Drive society-wide electrification

Today, only certain elements of society are powered by electricity and renewable energy – in fact,
only 20 percent of energy consumption is electricity.⁷ A key lever to creating a sustainable energy
system is to drive electrification forward and ensure mobility, heating, and industries can be
powered by electricity from renewables.

In some industries and sectors electrification is not feasible anytime soon. However, Power-to-X and
green hydrogen are well-known solutions that show great potential to address the challenges we face
– for example, by helping to shift steel production and heavy transport to renewable energy sources.

**The Offshore Partners is an independent service provider to offshore wind projects, oil & gas
majors, vessel operators, offshore installation contractors, investors, project and product
developers, and public authorities worldwide. We provide technical and project management services
for new build and conversion projects, for on- and offshore installation projects, recruitment and
crewing services, as well as operational support.**

We specialise in supporting new build, conversion and R&M projects of work vessels intended for
installation projects at sea. We have the expertise to support installation work at sea and on land.

# Your global full scope **maritime**** safety partner**

What if you only had to rely on one proven partner for all your maritime safety needs?

**VIKING Life-Saving Equipment** brings you all the solutions you need to stay safe and
compliant. Our range includes everything from lifeboats, fast rescue boats and evacuation systems to
liferafts, personal protective gear, firefighting equipment and safety training.

Powered by the industry’s strongest network, we provide worldwide multi-brand equipment service with
OEM quality and support the thousands of maritime and offshore operators who prefer subscribing to
safety compliance with a fixed price safety agreement.

**YOUR SAFETY **IS SAFE WITH US

85+ branch offices, 8 training academies, and 280+ certified service stations.

# Shaping the decarbonisation of marine and energy


Our everyday lives depend on a steady supply of electricity and goods shipped to us from across the
world.

Yet, marine and energy generate over a third of global greenhouse gases. That’s why we’re shaping
the decarbonisation of marine and energy.

[About us][8]

2050

net-zero target year
for shipping and energy

180

countries with our
energy installations

110,000

vessels sailing worldwide,
one-third using our solutions

3,500

Wärtsilä service professionals
in the field

## Enabling you to cut emissions at sea and on land

We help our customers take a decarbonisation journey that is environmentally sustainable and
financially viable.

[Senayan power plant in Indonesia]
[lightning-icon]
Energy

We help the energy sector accelerate the transition towards a 100% renewable energy future with our
market-leading technologies and power system expertise. Energy providers globally rely on our
flexible engine power plants, energy storage systems, intelligent optimisation technologies, and
lifecycle services. With reliable, affordable, and sustainable power as your goal, our solutions
support you in ramping up and balancing intermittent renewables.

[Wärtsilä in energy][9]
[Gas tanker on open sea]
[marine-icon]
Marine

With Wärtsilä as your partner, your maritime operations can be smarter, cleaner, and more efficient.
One in three of the world’s large vessels already relies on our technologies – power, propulsion and
other solutions – because you value reliability, safety, and performance. And as the industry moves
toward alternative fuels and digital ecosystems, we help you stay ahead with our future-proof
solutions.

[Wärtsilä in marine][10]
[Power plant in the desert]
[Service men at pier]
[Freight vessel in port]

## Interim report for April-June 2026 has been published

In the second quarter of 2026, Wärtsilä’s total order intake increased by 33% to 2,849 MEUR to an
all-time high quarter, contributing to an all-time high order book of 8,976 MEUR. The operating
result increased by 14% to EUR 209 million, representing 13.4% of net sales. Cash flow from
operating activities increased to EUR 497 million.

[Read more][11]

## Global impact. Succeeding together.

From world-first technology launches to performance-based agreements, we innovate to create value
with our customers and partners.

[
Solvang

Onboard carbon capture successfully cuts CO2 emissions by 70% for Solvang’s Clipper Eris carrier

][12][
Aqualectra, Curacao

Installed a new 38.4 MW grid balancing engine power plant in addition to the 25 MW / 45 MWh Energy
Storage System installed earlier.

][13][
GIGA Storage BV

Installed Wärtsilä's 25 MW / 48 MWh energy storage in the Netherlands, improving grid stability and
scaling renewable integration.

][14][
Viking Line

Finnish ferry company Viking Line is a market leader in passenger transport in the northern Baltic
Sea region.

][15][
United Power

United Power manages over 2,137 MW of installed capacity in Bangladesh, of which 1,066 MW is powered
by Wärtsilä engines.

][16][
Clearway Energy

Partnered with Wärtsilä for storage solutions supporting reliable renewable energy in California and
Hawaii.

][17]
[leaf-icon]
Green is not black or white.

While no single solution will carry us through the transition, we already have most of the
technology needed to decarbonise. From engines that run flexibly on low- and zero-carbon fuels to
AI-driven predictive analytics, we are using all tools in the toolbox to help our customers take the
next step on their decarbonisation journey.

As Andreas Berg Nielsen steps into the role of CEO at Windar Photonics, he believes the wind
industry is entering a new phase, one focused less on building bigger turbines and more on
extracting greater performance from existing assets. In this interview, he explains why optimisation
is becoming a core priority for asset owners, how Windar’s LiDAR technology is delivering measurable
returns within months and why the company sees enormous growth potential in the world’s ageing wind
fleet.

Seagreen in the North Sea, wind has moved from challenger technology to the largest single source of
